summary: 秋から冬にかけて考えているパンや小さな催しのメモをまとめました。

en.title: Notes from the bakery: what’s next
en.summary: Ideas for seasonal bread and small gatherings as autumn turns to winter.
en.cover_alt: An idea notebook on a kitchen table
en.html:
We spread our notebooks out on the kitchen table and jot down breads we would like to bake and small gatherings we hope to hold.

Ideas we’re exploring

  • Seasonal bread with apples and walnuts
  • Taking part in a neighborhood market
  • A peaceful afternoon around bread and warm drinks
en.markdown:
We spread our notebooks out on the kitchen table and jot down breads we would like to bake and small gatherings we hope to hold.

## Ideas we’re exploring

- Seasonal bread with apples and walnuts
- Taking part in a neighborhood market
- A peaceful afternoon around bread and warm drinks

markdown:
台所のテーブルにノートを広げて、これから焼いてみたいパンや、小さな集まりのことを書き出しています。

## 今考えていること

- りんごやくるみを使った季節のパン
- 小さなマーケットへの出店
- パンと飲みものを囲む、静かな午後の時間
